SEO AUDIT

Clear Lake Dental Care — SEO audit

Three specific fixes, with approved booking and tracking preserved.

220 sitemap URLs · 225 distinct HTML pages · read-only · October 7

Business and treatment schema needs correctionThe hero video and hidden widget load earlyTwo confirmation pages are eligible for searchFix order
01

Business and treatment schema needs correction

The business schema uses a North Carolina map pin, 55 treatment Product blocks contain invalid JSON/pricing, and 143 practice authors are typed as people.

  • Replace the 225 Dentist and homepage LocalBusiness coordinates with the verified Webster pin: 29.5428294, -95.1249342.
  • Remove only the 55 invalid Product overlays; use Organization for the practice’s Article author and keep valid Service, FAQ and business data.
02

The hero video and hidden widget load early

Mobile labs scored 39–41/100; a fresh visit downloaded 10.5 MB of the hero video before interaction, while the hidden Weave form also started heavy scripts.

  • Optimize clearlakedental-15sec-video.mp4 or use an approved mobile fallback/source-loading policy; preserve image quality and the hero layout.
  • Load the hidden Weave conversation on demand if the vendor supports it; keep booking, chat, CAPTCHA and tracking, then retest.
03

Two confirmation pages are eligible for search

The form and booking thank-you pages are index-follow and included in the XML sitemap, although they are post-submission screens.

  • Set /thank-you/ and /thank-you-booking/ to noindex, follow and exclude just these two URLs from XML.
  • Keep both URLs, approved booking destinations and conversion tracking unchanged; do not delete or redirect them.
Complete two-page indexing scope — expand page-level changes

Fix order

Correct the schema, reduce confirmed early-loading costs, then exclude the two confirmation pages from search.

  • Website: one schema package and quality-preserving video/widget loading work, with staging checks.
  • SEO: validate the two noindex exclusions and preserve healthy sitemap aliases, tracking roles and approved work.

Lab results are not real-user performance. Source maps identify public output, not verified WordPress emitter IDs. No live changes.
